macro.name: Logic.OneOffI18N.FalseRemark
macro.description: Bilingual authored explanation for the logic library.

en.body: The inductive proposition #0 has no constructors. From a hypothetical proof of #0, empty elimination produces an inhabitant of any Sort u; the absence of constructors does not prevent stating this conditional rule.

zh-CN.body: 归纳命题 #0 没有构造子。从假设的 #0 证明出发，空消去可以给出任意 Sort u 中的对象；没有构造子并不妨碍陈述这条条件规则。
